mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS callCount, COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0 ) AS successCount, COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0 ) AS failureCount, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2 ) END AS successRate, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)), 0) AS averageDurationMs FROM ai_model_usage WHERE created_at >= #{startTime}

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(model_code, ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS modelCode, MAX(provider) AS provider, MAX(model_name) AS modelName, COUNT(*) AS callCount, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failureCount, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2 ) END AS successRate, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)), 0) AS averageDurationMs FROM ai_model_usage WHERE created_at >= #{startTime} GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(model_code, ''), 'UNKNOWN') ORDER BY callCount DESC, modelCode ASC

SELECT run_id AS runId, model_code AS modelCode, provider AS provider, model_name AS modelName, call_type AS callType, error_category AS errorCategory, duration_ms AS durationMs, created_at AS createdAt FROM ai_model_usage WHERE success = 0 AND created_at >= #{startTime} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
